d: India has strongly rejected China’s objections to identifying 28 strategic locations in Ladakh, reaffirming the region as an integral part of the country amid longstanding border tensions. Meanwhile, Netflix is cutting around 1,000 jobs despite reporting $3.4 billion in profit and $12.56 billion in Q2 2026 revenue. Firstpost examines India-China territorial disputes, the politics of maps and sovereignty, alongside Netflix’s workforce cuts, rising costs and growing competition from YouTube and other streaming rivals.
